content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate Degree (preferably in M.Sc. in Clinical Research or equivalent) including the integrated PG degrees, with three years post qualification experience; OR PhD Experience: Three years post qualification experience with a PG degree (or PhD); Experience row of the notice says NA Age limit: Maximum 35 years Age relaxation: Age relaxation will be provided as per ICMR guidelines Other conditions: Selected candidate will have to join immediately. Desirable: Familiarity with HPLC (preferably size-exclusion chromatography) Stability testing of pharmaceutical/biological products as per ICH guidelines Preparation and characterization of lipid-based vesicular systems (DLS, zeta potential, UV-Vis spectrophotometry) Basic data analysis Working knowledge of image analysis or Python will be an added advantage

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Project duration is 3 years; initial appointment for 1 year. Contract renewable subject to satisfactory performance and sanction of budget from ICMR. Appointment purely on temporary basis; no guarantee of job or PhD admission in Jamia Hamdard. Temporary project appointment will not be counted as experience for jobs in Jamia Hamdard.
